issues.text: AssignmentSource.queued's default value (`timezone.now()`) is evaluated once at class-definition/module-import time, not per instance, so every AssignmentSource created without an explicit queued value shares the same frozen timestamp instead of the actual enqueue time.
issues.zh: AssignmentSource.queued 的預設值在 module import 時就算完了，之後每個實例拿到的都是同一個時間戳

issues.text: The new assignment_source parameter added to IssueSyncIntegration.sync_status_outbound has no producer and no consumer anywhere in the repo, and its declared signature is incompatible with ExampleIntegration's implementation, which doesn't even accept **kwargs.
issues.zh: sync_status_outbound 新增的 assignment_source 參數沒有生產者也沒有消費者，且與 ExampleIntegration 的實作不相容

issues.text: AssignmentSource.from_dict swallows parse failures and returns None; since the caller treats None as "no source" and the guard is `if sync_source and ...`, a parse failure silently disables the outbound-sync loop protection with no logging or metric to reveal it happened.
issues.zh: from_dict 解析失敗時回傳 None，等於無聲關閉迴圈保護，且沒有留下任何 log 或 metric

issues.text: test_to_dict only asserts that queued `is not None`, an assertion too weak to catch the shared-default-timestamp bug described in F-001 even though this test is the only place that exercises the queued field.
issues.zh: test_to_dict 對 queued 只斷言 is not None，剛好放過了 F-001 的預設值缺陷

issues.text: Test method name test_from_dict_inalid_data has a typo — missing the 'v' — and should be test_from_dict_invalid_data.
issues.zh: 第 13 行的 test_from_dict_inalid_data 少了一個 v，應為 invalid

issues.text: Test method name test_from_dict_empty_array is misleading: the input it actually tests is an empty dict, not an array.
issues.zh: 第 8 行的 test_from_dict_empty_array 測的輸入是第 9 行的 data: dict[str, Any] = {}，是空 dict 不是 array

issues.text: The ~30-45 line integration + ExternalIssue + GroupLink test setup is now duplicated verbatim for the third time by this PR's new test, triggering the Rule of Three, and risks silent drift since the 5-key sync config dict must stay consistent across every copy.
issues.zh: 測試前置設定出現第三份逐字複本，觸發 Rule of Three

issues.text: No test verifies that a different integration still propagates changes outward — only the same-integration blocking case is tested — so an inverted guard condition (blocking everything instead of only the matching source) would still pass all existing tests.
issues.zh: issues.py:387-389 的註解明說 guard「should still allow other integrations to propagate changes outward」，但沒有任何測試涵蓋這一半

issues.text: The new test exercises the guard by calling GroupAssignee.objects.assign(assignment_source=...) directly rather than through the real entry point sync_group_assignee_inbound, so the actual end-to-end behavior ("webhook comes in → no outbound re-send to the same integration") remains untested.
issues.zh: 新測試是在 GroupAssignee.objects.assign(assignment_source=...) 這一層驗證的，但真正會產生 assignment_source 的入口是 sync_group_assignee_inbound，目前沒有任何測試守著

issues.text: The deassign-direction loop guard (matching source) has no corresponding test.
issues.zh: deassign 方向的 guard（groupassignee.py:238-240）同樣沒有對應的 matching-source 測試

open_questions.text: Does the same-integration loop guard actually stop a multi-integration back-and-forth (A → Sentry → B → Sentry → A) when two or more issue-sync integrations are linked to the same group, and which loop originally motivated this fix?
open_questions.zh: 這個 guard 只擋得住「同一個 integration 的單跳回彈」。當一個 organization 有兩個以上的 issue-sync integration 同時 link 到同一個 group 時，A → Sentry → B → Sentry → A 的來回是否也會被擋下？如果不會，實際觸發這次修復的那個迴圈屬於哪一種？

open_questions.text: During a rolling deploy, will the retry configuration on sync_assignee_outbound tolerate the window where new code enqueues an assignment_source_dict kwarg that old workers' function signature can't accept (causing a TypeError)?
open_questions.zh: 在 rolling deploy 期間，新版程式送出的 sync_assignee_outbound 任務多帶了 assignment_source_dict 這個 kwarg，被尚未更新的 worker 取走時會直接 TypeError；現有的 retry 設定是否足以撐過部署窗口？

open_questions.text: Is src/sentry/integrations/services/ the right home for AssignmentSource, given the rest of that directory is hybrid-cloud RPC service layer and AssignmentSource is a plain non-RPC frozen dataclass?
open_questions.zh: AssignmentSource 放在 src/sentry/integrations/services/ 是否是它該在的位置？
